nodes.description: Public mapping tracking token balances; mutated directly without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of owner->spender->amount allowances.
Total token supply, set once in the constructor.
Private owner address; gate for delegate and batchSend.
Constant router address 0x7a25...488D used for the initial infinite allowance.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Constant decimals = 18.
payable transfer() that simply delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic.
payable approve() that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-allowance safety.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall into an arbitrary user-supplied address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only bulk transfer; computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath and emits duplicate Transfer events.
Pure function computing a Uniswap-V2 style pair address from factory, tokenA and tokenB.
Modifier computing the UNI pair via pairFor and requiring _from or _to to be the owner or the computed pair.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, full supply and an infinite allowance to the router.
msg.sender; caller identity used for auth checks, allowance spending and balance accounting.
Low-level delegatecall to an attacker-controlled address, allowing storage hijack or complete takeover.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in Solidity 0.5 can overflow and corrupt the total accounting.
Unchecked subtraction on balances/allowances (balanceOf[_from] -= _value, allowance -= _value, balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total).
Transfer events emitted per recipient; batchSend emits two half-value events, breaking off-chain accounting.
_to recipient address parameter of transfer/transferFrom and of the ensure modifier.
_value amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom (and _value of batchSend).
_from source address parameter of transferFrom and of the ensure modifier.
_spender address parameter of approve.
a: arbitrary target address passed to delegatecall in delegate.
b: arbitrary calldata bytes forwarded to delegatecall in delegate.
_tos: array of recipient addresses supplied by the owner to batchSend.
total = _value * _tos.length computed in batchSend without SafeMath.
Loop counter i in batchSend.
Loop-local _to = _tos[i] inside batchSend.
UNI local inside the ensure modifier holding pairFor(...) result.
_name constructor argument stored into state name.
_symbol constructor argument stored into state symbol.
_supply constructor argument used as totalSupply and initial balance.
factory address parameter of pairFor.
tokenA parameter of pairFor.
tokenB parameter of pairFor.
pair address computed by CREATE2-style hashing in pairFor.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as _from into transferFrom.
transferFrom branches on msg.sender != _from to decide whether to spend allowance.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before delegatecall.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
Constructor assigns owner and full balance to msg.sender.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transfer passes _to as recipient.
transfer passes _value as amount.
transferFrom is guarded by the ensure(_from,_to) modifier.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom updates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance -= _value are unchecked subtractions.
transferFrom consumes the user-supplied _value.
transferFrom debits the caller-supplied _from.
transferFrom emits a Transfer event.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
approve uses _spender as the allowance key.
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary target, hijacking this contract's storage.
delegate uses parameter a as the delegatecall target.
delegate forwards parameter b as raw calldata to the delegatecall.
batchSend multiplies _value by _tos.length with no SafeMath.
batchSend iterates over the owner-supplied _tos array.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length, an overflow-prone local.
batchSend increments the loop counter i.
batchSend copies _tos[i] into the loop-local _to.
batchSend subtracts from balanceOf[msg.sender] and adds to balanceOf[_to].
batchSend total arithmetic can overflow and mis-account balances.
batchSend performs balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked.
batchSend emits two Transfer events of _value/2 per recipient.
User-supplied _value feeds the unchecked multiplication.
Array length of _tos feeds the unchecked multiplication.
ensure modifier calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
ensure stores the pairFor result in the local UNI variable.
ensure compares _from/_to against owner and the computed pair derived from the UNI router state.
ensure constrains which _from addresses may trigger transferFrom.
ensure constrains which _to addresses are accepted.
ensure requires _from == owner || _to == owner || _from == UNI.
pairFor uses the factory parameter in the address hash.
pairFor uses tokenA in the pair hash.
pairFor uses tokenB in the pair hash.
pairFor computes and returns the local pair address.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply.
Constructor mints the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][router] = uint(-1).
Constructor consumes the _name argument.
Constructor consumes the _symbol argument.
Constructor consumes the _supply argument.
Constructor stores _name into the name state variable.
Constructor stores _symbol into the symbol state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of transfer and its downstream transferFrom call.
_value is the amount consumed by transferFrom when mutating allowance and balances.
_from is the debited account validated by the ensure modifier and allowance check.
_spender is solely the allowance key written by approve.
parameter a is only used as the delegatecall target.
parameter b is only used as raw calldata for the delegatecall.
_tos is the recipient array iterated by the batchSend loop.
total is the direct result of the unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication.
loop counter i exists only to drive the batchSend for-loop.
loop-local _to is only the per-iteration recipient derived from _tos[i].
local UNI holds the pairFor result used in the ensure modifier's authorization require.
_name is consumed only by the constructor when initializing state.
_symbol is consumed only by the constructor when initializing state.
_supply is consumed only by the constructor to set totalSupply and mint balances.
factory is used only as a hash ingredient inside pairFor.
tokenA is used only to order/hash the pair in pairFor.
tokenB is used only to order/hash the pair in pairFor.
pair is the computed return value of pairFor.
